rules.unit: credit hours of continuing medical education
rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA-accredited Category I CME; AOA-accredited Category I or II CME
rules.alternatives: Accepted as equivalent: a current AMA/AOA (or recognized subspecialty board) Physician's Recognition Award; initial certification or recertification by an AMA- or AOA-recognized specialty board during the licensing period; participation in a residency program during the licensing period. Extension/exemption possible for extenuating circumstances (illness, injury).
rules.audit_note: Signed statement of compliance at renewal; the board may request evidence and audit. Keep evidence of compliance.

topics.who: Pain management and opioid use and addiction; not required if the licensee certifies they hold no valid DEA registration

rules.notes: Regulation requires an average of 25 credit hours per year of the previous (biennial) license period, i.e. 50 per renewal. One board for MDs and DOs (osteopaths). License expiry date not stated on the pages read.
